bounded_definition.definition: A bounded control-loop hypothesis in which algorithmic monitoring and management can make disagreement, deviation, or nonconformity easier to classify as risk and easier to remove from the future evidence population.

countervailing_evidence: Algorithmic feedback can support constructive voice in one matched field study.
Privacy-preserving aggregation and product restrictions can reduce individual surveillance risk.
Worker participation, transparency, and genuine challenge mechanisms can mitigate psychosocial and legitimacy harms.
Safety, quality, fraud, and security monitoring can serve legitimate purposes when bounded and accountable.
hard_refusals: AI caused Chloe Moffat to die.
Every HR analytics product is designed to eliminate dissent.
Every disciplined or quiet worker is a victim of an algorithm.
Every disagreement is legally protected activity.
A human click automatically makes an automated decision meaningful or fair.
Reduced variance, complaint volume, or attrition proves organizational health.

stages.description: Communication, time, speed, location, task, access, feedback, health, or behavioral traces are collected.
Employer or vendor defines expected productivity, tone, sentiment, risk, compliance, or behavioral patterns.
Worker activity is reduced to a score, threshold, flag, rank, theme, or anomaly.
The output enters a managerial, HR, security, compliance, or investigation queue.
Qualitative work context, disability, protected activity, safety concerns, disagreement, and local conditions may be absent or secondary.
A human receives the system output under time, workload, hierarchy, or automation-bias pressure.
Work, pay, shifts, access, account status, promotion, duties, reputation, or employment security may be constrained.
Workers may self-censor, conform, alter behavior, avoid scrutiny, or leave rather than contest the model.
Those disciplined, deactivated, rejected, silenced, or exited generate less future organizational evidence.
The remaining workforce supplies the observable labels, norms, ratings, and behavioral traces.
Future thresholds, prompts, dashboards, and managerial expectations are tuned on the quieter survivor population.
The institution can experience lower variance as proof of fit, safety, engagement, or performance rather than as evidence of suppressed voice.

system_breaks: purpose limitation and complete data-source custody
protected activity, safety, accommodation, and whistleblowing carve-outs
worker notice, access, explanation, correction, and appeal
independent welfare and support custody before adverse action
meaningful human review with time, competence, and override authority
worker and representative participation in design and evaluation
overturned, appealed, exited, and externally observed outcomes in validation
vendor concentration, model drift, and survivor-bias audit
